facts.text: I am planning a wedding gift for my cousin who just got engaged to his long-time girlfriend from India.
My cousin is engaged to his long-time girlfriend from India.
I like the idea of a customized photo album or frame.
I want to incorporate Indian elements into the design of the photo album or frame.
I want to use Indian-inspired fonts for the photo album.
I want the font to be legible and fit well with the overall design.
I am thinking of using a Devanagari-based font for the title of the photo album.
I am thinking of using a sans-serif font with Indian influences for the rest of the text.
I want a color scheme that complements these fonts and adds an Indian touch to the design.
I think I will use traditional Indian colors of red and gold for the title.
I think I will use a softer coral and pink palette for the rest of the text.
I like the idea of using a cream or beige background to let the fonts and colors stand out.
I want to add Indian-inspired patterns or motifs to the design, such as henna patterns or Indian florals.
I think I will add subtle henna patterns as accents to the design, maybe in the corners of the pages or as separators between sections.
I like the idea of incorporating Indian florals using delicate illustrations of marigolds or jasmine flowers.
I will use Indian florals sparingly and balance them with negative space to create a clean and uncluttered design.
I want online resources or tools to create Indian-inspired patterns and motifs.

online resources for patterns and motifs
